plan.summary: Zoho Adim 4 — Stage mapping editor (read-only P3-B2 sayfasini editable'a cevir). Integrations: GET /api/v1/zoho/blueprint/transitions (module-level, cached 10dk) + POST /api/v1/zoho/stage-mappings/test (dry-run, transition_id validation). Backend proxy: PUT /api/v1/zoho/stage-mappings (P3-B1 deferred) + GET blueprint/transitions + POST stage-mappings/test. Dashboard ZohoStageMappingPage: 7 lifecycle event satiri (welcome_sent/engaged/qualified/offer_sent/closed_won/deposit_paid/closed_lost), her biri Zoho transition dropdown + Test buton + Delete (satir clear) + Kaydet buton + Discover buton (cache bypass). Connection-yok gate (AC4) + banner.
plan.q_intent: Q: 'Stage mapping UI (P4) yap' — Tier 1 blokeri. Tenant dashboard'da read-only mevcut; editable hale getir. Zoho Blueprint transition'lari dropdown'dan secilsin. 4 AC: transitions dropdown dolu gelir, 7 event mapping PUT, reload'ta preselect, connection-yok editor disable + banner. Single paket API+UI.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari: (a) tum 4 scope (dropdown + discover + delete + test); (b) transitions endpoint Integrations tabanli (cached); (c) tek paket; (d) 4 AC. Architectural: (a) module-level transitions /crm/v6/settings/blueprint?module=Leads — yeni IZohoBlueprintClient.GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync; (b) delete row = local state'ten cikar + full Replace PUT (mevcut ReplaceAsync upsert); ayri DELETE endpoint YOK (scope control); (c) test endpoint transition_id whitelist validation — transitions listesinde var mi kontrol; (d) connection-yok gate = client tarafi GET /api/v1/zoho/connection check.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tenant /integrations/zoho/stage-mappings sayfasi acilinca Backend proxy GET /api/v1/zoho/blueprint/transitions -> Integrations GET /api/v1/zoho/blueprint/transitions -> ZohoBlueprintClient.GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync(tenantId) cagirir; Zoho settings/blueprint API'sinden transition'lar cekilir, cache 10dk (key: zoho:bp:all:{tenantId}). Response: {items:[{transitionId, name, nextState?}]}. Transitions dropdown dolu gelir.

7 event icin transition secilip 'Kaydet' butonu -> Backend proxy PUT /api/v1/zoho/stage-mappings body {mappings:[{zohoEvent, zohoTransitionId, zohoTransitionName?}]} -> Integrations PUT (mevcut P3-B1). ZohoStageMappingService.ReplaceAsync tenant_id scoped full-upsert: yeni liste mevcut rowlari siler + yazar. Sadece secili event'ler persist. 200 response -> UI 'Kaydedildi' bildirimi.
Sayfa yeniden yuklendiginde GET /api/v1/zoho/stage-mappings mevcut kayitlari getirir; dropdown'lar kaydedilmis transition_id ile preselect olur (UI state dolu gelir).

Zoho bagli degilken (GET /api/v1/zoho/connection response.connected=false) sayfa info banner ('Once Zoho hesabinizi baglayin' + /integrations/zoho/connection linki) + tum form field'lari (dropdown, Kaydet, Test, Discover) disabled.

Test buton (per-row): Backend proxy POST /api/v1/zoho/stage-mappings/test body {zohoEvent, zohoTransitionId} -> Integrations POST -> GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync'ten transition_id whitelist kontrol; bulunursa {valid:true, transitionName}, bulunmazsa {valid:false, reason:'Transition not found in Blueprint'} (INV-INT-122). UI row-local banner gosterir.

Discover buton: cache bypass (IMemoryCache.Remove) + yeni fetch. Backend proxy GET /api/v1/zoho/blueprint/transitions?refresh=true -> Integrations endpoint refresh=true ise cache sil + fresh fetch. UI loading indicator + fresh dropdown.
Full sln build PASS + Dashboard build PASS. Mikroservis izolasyonu: Backend -> Integrations HTTP only, ProjectReference yok.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync yeni method — module-level settings/blueprint endpoint kullanir, lead-scoped existing GetLeadTransitionsAsync ile farkli cache key.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Editor UX'i tum transitions'a ihtiyac duyar (state-bagimsiz). Lead-scoped API sadece o lead'in suandaki state'inden cikan transition'lari doner — editor dropdown eksik olur. Settings API Zoho'nun blueprint metadata'sini vermek icindir.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ4 'duplicate code' diyebilir (mevcut GetLeadTransitionsAsync ile benzer parsing). Kabul: farkli semantik (module vs record-level), farkli cache key (zoho:bp:all:{tid} vs zoho:bp:{tid}:{leadId}); duplication intentional.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Delete row = client tarafi state'ten cikar + full ReplaceAsync PUT (server tarafi DELETE endpoint YOK).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: ZohoStageMappingService.ReplaceAsync tenant-scoped full-upsert (mevcut listedeki tum row'lari siler + yazar). UI'dan row silme = local mapping state'ten event'i cikar + Save. Ayri DELETE endpoint scope creep; partial semantik karmasasi (sync log rows orphan olabilir).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'neden ayri DELETE endpoint yok' diyebilir. Kabul: ReplaceAsync zaten idempotent full-upsert; client silme = liste'den kaldir + Save. Tek source of truth.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Test endpoint dry-run sadece transitions whitelist check — Zoho'ya PUT atmaz.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Test semantik = 'mapping dogru kurulmus mu'. Gercek PUT dry-run degil gercek mutation olur. Blueprint.GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync sonucunda transition_id whitelist check yeterli (user'in secimi hala var mi).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex Q4 'test Zoho'ya cagri yapmalidir' diyebilir. Kabul: gercek PUT test side-effect; whitelist kontrol state-independent dogrulama yeterli.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Test endpoint invalid whitelist cikisi 200 OK + {Valid:false, ErrorCode:'INV-INT-122', Reason:'INV-INT-122: ...'} envelope — error HTTP status (404/409) DEGIL.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Endpoint semantik 'validation check' (success/failure result), failed action DEGIL. Whitelist-miss = beklenen path, UI duzgun banner gostermeli. ErrorCode alani INV-INT-122 surface eder (arch/errors.md BlueprintTransitionNotFound kodu compliance). Valid=true durumu da ayni envelope kullanir (tutarli sozlesme).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ1/CQ9/CQ12 '404 INV-INT-122 olmali' diyebilir. Kabul: 200 envelope + ErrorCode alani actionable (UI for both valid/invalid ayni DTO'yu tuketir, test result banner gosterir). Test yalniz whitelist kontrol, failed action degil.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Dashboard TS DTO'lar Shared.Contracts.Zoho C# DTO'lariyla manuel mirror — tek shared contract codegen YOK.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Proje genelinde (P3-B1, P3-B2, P3-C dahil) TS ↔ C# DTO'lar elle mirror'lanir; codegen pipeline yok. C# PascalCase init-only + TS camelCase interface dil-uyumu farki. Yeni sozlesme iki tarafa ekleyerek senkronize tutulur.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ8 'contract drift risk' diyebilir. Kabul: proje-wide pattern (20+ DTO ciftinde ayni); codegen ayri paket scope; bu paket scope'unda mirror tutarliligi yeterli (P3-B1/B2/C hepsi boyle PASS etti).
